## See inside every agent run

Claude Code runs under your policy through its hooks: each tool call is allowed, blocked or sent to a person. Codex and Gemini CLI report every step over OpenTelemetry. Pause or stop any session from the dashboard.

## Policy and audit

Decide which templates, sizes, run times and agents each project may use, and which calls need a person first. Every sandbox, workspace, lease and change lands in a hash-chained audit log you can export.

## Start free. Scale when your agents do.

(Every plan runs on the same isolated microVMs.)

Sandboxes, workspaces and build hosts all draw from your plan's monthly awake hours. A box counts only while it is awake: paused and idle time between tool calls is free. Pro gives one developer room to work; Team adds the controls a company needs; Enterprise adds your own cloud and your own keys.

On paid plans you choose what happens when your included hours run out: turn usage beyond them on at $0.05 per awake vCPU-hour, add an hour pack of 500 awake vCPU-hours for $10, or keep it off and new boxes wait for next month. Running boxes are never stopped. Set spend caps per task, agent, project and organization.

Need bigger machines? Pro runs boxes of up to 16 vCPU, Team up to 32 on request, and Enterprise up to 64. Every box gets exactly the vCPUs and memory you picked, plus any burst you set, never more.
